shortlist.title: Learning in Public: The First Ten Deliberate Hours of a New Skill
shortlist.hook: This is a first draft, and it says so on purpose.
shortlist.angle: a first draft of skill: what ten deliberate, logged hours teach that a hundred casual ones never will, with the honest numbers of a beginner

shortlist.title: One Month, Fewer Screens: What It Did to My Attention and My Budget
shortlist.hook: I ran this like an accounting experiment, because that is how my head works.
shortlist.angle: an honest month of reduced screen time measured two ways: attention and money, no preaching, numbers and letdowns included

shortlist.title: The Doorway Rule: Why Every Screen Habit Should Have a Threshold
shortlist.hook: The machine I am writing on can do everything.
shortlist.angle: a month of assigning doorways to contexts, no feeds in the work room and no work in the bed, measured against the old everywhere-machine

shortlist.title: Thirty Minutes on Sunday That Buy Back a Week
shortlist.hook: I have attempted the weekly review six or seven times in my life, the way other people attempt jogging.
shortlist.angle: a plain weekly review, why it kept failing, and the one change that made it stick
